Cc: ops@novaai.com
Date: 2026-11-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Sudden jump in p95/p99 after model swap (help)

Hi Laura,

We flipped the model variant to v3-canary this morning as discussed and immediately saw a sharp increase in p95 and p99 latency on our hosted endpoints. p95 moved from ~220ms to ~820ms and p99 is spiking above 2.5s. Error rate is low but throughput has dropped (retries from our side). Can you confirm if anything changed on Redwood's side during the 09:00–09:05 UTC window?

I attached a short trace file and our internal graph. This is customer-facing traffic and impacting a major job run. ETA-critical.

Thanks,
Jenna Park
Director of Platform Engineering
NovaAI

- Laura

From: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-11-02T09:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden jump in p95/p99 after model swap (help)

I'm seeing the same spike correlated with the rollout window. Initial findings:
- Canary variant v3-canary shows a 3x increase in KV-cache miss rate for prism-attention kernels.
- Host-level GPU queue latency rose on a subset of pods that received the canary traffic (profile attached).
- No upstream infra deployments at 09:00; this looks model-exec path related (kernel selection + sequence-length regression).

Proposal: immediate targeted rollback of Nova's canary traffic to v2-stable, then run a throttled A/B with instrumentation to isolate sequence-length distribution differences. I can trigger rollback if you approve.

- Marcus (SRE Lead)

Date: 2026-11-02T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Rollback completed — NovaAI (v3-canary -> v2-stable)

Rollback completed at 10:16 UTC. Preliminary monitoring:
- p95 returned to ~240ms within two minutes of rollback.
- p99 back under 600ms; throughput normalized.
- Captured kernel traces and per-pod profiles for the canary cohort; pushed to JIRA INF-1287.

Next steps:
1) Deep dive on KV cache behavior and kernel selection differences (owner: infra/systems).
2) Reproduce with a controlled A/B in a subset of traffic with sequence-length sampling.
3) Customer post-mortem and potential SLA credit discussion (owner: AE/CS).

Attaching rollback_runbook_v1.pdf and trace bundle.

- Marcus

If the write-up indicates a broader risk for other customers, we'll schedule an exec sync with Customer Success leadership.
